decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed change of use would result in a net loss of
industrial floorspace from the borough stocks, for which there is an evidenced
strategic need to retain. The submitted information is unable to justify this
loss of floorspace, therefore the proposal is contrary to Policy E4 of the
London Plan (2021), policy CS1 (O) of Harrow’s Core Strategy (2012) and policy
DM 31 C and D of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate that the proposed Banqueting Hall &nbsp;(Sui
Generis) would be a compatible use with the adjoining industrial uses within
the Brember Road Industrial Park, and not to the detriment of existing
occupiers within the Industrial Park. The proposal therefore fails to accord
with policies DM1, DM31 and DM46 of the Harrow Development Management policies
Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate whether the proposed Banqueting Hall
&nbsp;(Sui Generis), would not unacceptably harm the free flow and safety of
the highway. There are concerns that the proposal would result in injudicious
parking within the Brember Road Industrial Park and adjoining residential
streets thereby exacerbating an already congested parking situation to the
detriment of neighbouring amenity and highway and pedestrian safety. The proposal
therefore fails to accord with policies T.6 and T6.4 of The London Plan (2021),
and policies DM1, DM42 and DM46 of the Harrow Development Management policies
Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Insufficient information has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate that&nbsp;the proposed Banqetting Hall would
not lead to adverse impacts on the amenity of neighbouring residential
properties. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with policies DM1 and
DM46 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and
policy&nbsp;D14 of the London Plan (2021).&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
description: Temporary part change of use from warehouse (B8) to community hall (Sui Generis) on ground floor level
